en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a formal garden in a city park. A sandy path runs straight ahead under a green metal arch covered with climbing plants and flowers. On both sides of the path are manicured lawns, flower beds, and two potted trees in the foreground. In the distance, more flower arrangements and trellises are visible, with dense trees forming the background. Printed red text at the top reads "Wurzen i. Sa." on the left and "Im Stadtpark." on the right.
